coordinateScale: dimensionless l; new physical scale not established

modes.title: One sideways reading
modes.headline: Outward motion and swirl can be mixed together.
modes.explanation: One horizontal velocity component is only one projection of two unknown motions. More locations do not remove that ambiguity without extra assumptions. At special angles one motion is directly observed; the other still is not.

modes.title: Three directions at one point
modes.headline: Separate the local directions of motion.
modes.explanation: Two horizontal components separate outward motion from swirl at this point. The third component measures downward motion. Calibration is still essential; one point cannot establish symmetry.

modes.title: Rings at three heights
modes.headline: Check whether the same picture holds around the wake.
modes.explanation: Two rings, eight positions per ring, three heights: 48 planned locations. Three signed components at each location permit sampled comparisons. These are spatial sites, not independent repeats, and cannot certify the entire wake.

limitations: Proposed measurements only; no new flow data or speed values.
Direction arrows have arbitrary lengths; they do not show airspeed.
Physical scale, facility, precision and model amplitude remain unresolved.
